preset.description: Complete visual starting point. Add only the overrides the site actually needs.

oneOf.title: Portfolio
oneOf.description: For portfolios and image-led sites, with restrained typography and generous space for images.

oneOf.title: Documentation
oneOf.description: For guides and reference material, with reading-focused typography and compact spacing.

oneOf.title: Project
oneOf.description: For project and product sites that balance explanation, code, cards, and images.

oneOf.title: Statement
oneOf.description: For short, expressive sites, with larger typography, airy spacing, and stronger section emphasis.

preset.markdownDescription:
```yaml
preset: documentation
```

Selects coordinated corners, layout, image sizing, content-block defaults, typography, palette and section backgrounds. This is the normal starting point for a theme.

[Compare theme presets](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#theme-presets)

default.description: Initial color mode. System follows the visitor's operating-system preference.

oneOf.title: System
oneOf.description: Follow the visitor's operating-system light or dark preference.

oneOf.title: Light
oneOf.description: Start with the palette's light appearance.

oneOf.title: Dark
oneOf.description: Start with the palette's dark appearance.

default.markdownDescription:
```yaml
colorMode:
  default: system
```

Initial color mode. System follows the visitor's operating-system preference.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#color-mode)

colorMode.description: Site-wide light and dark mode behaviour.
colorMode.markdownDescription:
```yaml
colorMode:
  default: system
```

Controls the initial light or dark appearance. Enable the reader-facing choice under readerControls.

[Color mode](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#color-mode)

defaultSnippets.label: Set the initial color mode
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription:

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#color-mode)

colorMode.description: Let readers choose System, Light, or Dark color mode in the site-wide Display panel.
colorMode.markdownDescription:
```yaml
readerControls:
  colorMode: true
```

Let readers choose System, Light, or Dark color mode in the site-wide Display panel.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#reader-display-controls)

focusReading.description: Let readers temporarily hide navigation and other secondary page chrome while reading. Tree navigation always provides this control.
focusReading.markdownDescription:
```yaml
readerControls:
  focusReading: true
```

Let readers temporarily hide navigation and other secondary page chrome while reading. Tree navigation always provides this control.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#reader-display-controls)

readerControls.description: Optional site-wide reader choices grouped with the always-available reading-width choice in the Display panel.
readerControls.markdownDescription:
```yaml
readerControls:
  colorMode: true
  focusReading: true
```

Adds optional color-mode and focus-reading choices to the site-wide Display panel. Reading width is always available, and tree navigation always provides Focus reading.

[Reader Display controls](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#reader-display-controls)

defaultSnippets.label: Configure the Display panel
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription:
Offer optional color-mode and focus-reading choices alongside the universal reading-width control. Tree navigation always provides Focus reading.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#reader-display-controls)

width.description: Default maximum width for card lists. A width written in a norna-card-list block overrides this value.

oneOf.title: Text width

Default maximum width for card lists. A width written in a norna-card-list block overrides this value.

cardList.markdownDescription:

palette.description: Coordinated site color palette. Every palette provides light and dark variants. Omit this to use the selected preset.

oneOf.title: Near monochrome
oneOf.description: Neutral grays and off-whites with almost no visible hue. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Warm paper
oneOf.description: Warm off-whites and browns resembling paper and ink. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Retro earth
oneOf.description: Earthy ochres, olives and warm neutrals with a subdued retro character. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Clay rose
oneOf.description: Muted clay, rose and wine tones with a warm editorial character. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Forest moss
oneOf.description: Botanical greens, mossy surfaces and warm lichen neutrals. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Mineral teal
oneOf.description: Cool mineral greens with muted teal accents and pale aqua-gray surfaces. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Arctic blue
oneOf.description: Cool blue-gray surfaces with clear, restrained blue accents. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Soft lavender
oneOf.description: Quiet lavender surfaces with low-key mauve accents. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

oneOf.title: Vivid night
oneOf.description: Indigo surfaces with a brighter cyan accent and a dark-first character. Includes coordinated light and dark variants.

palette.markdownDescription:
```yaml
palette: warm-paper
```

Chooses the site color character. Every palette provides coordinated light and dark variants.

[Palette and color mode](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#palette-and-color-mode)

backgroundPattern.description: Section background pattern. Alternating and accented create full-width bands with sections or top navigation; tree navigation requires uniform.

oneOf.title: Uniform
oneOf.description: Use the normal page background for every H2 section. Tree navigation requires this pattern.

oneOf.title: Alternating
oneOf.description: Alternate normal and subtly contrasting full-width section backgrounds. Available with sections and top navigation.

oneOf.title: Accented
oneOf.description: Move through base, soft, emphasis and soft full-width section backgrounds before repeating. Available with sections and top navigation.

backgroundPattern.markdownDescription:
```yaml
sections:
  backgroundPattern: alternating
```

Section background pattern. Alternating and accented create full-width bands with sections or top navigation; tree navigation requires uniform.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#section-backgrounds)

sections.markdownDescription:
```yaml
sections:
  backgroundPattern: alternating
```

Chooses whether H2 section backgrounds stay uniform, alternate between two backgrounds or move from base to soft to emphasis and back through soft. Non-uniform patterns are available with sections and top navigation; tree navigation requires uniform.

[Section backgrounds](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.18/docs/theme.md#section-backgrounds)

description: Site-wide visual identity and default page presentation. Presets may be selected only in the root theme.

markdownDescription:

```yaml
preset: documentation
```
